prompt: Single continuous shot, no cuts. Opens mid-action: eggplants halved boldly, flesh scored in a diamond pattern, olive oil brushed on glistening. The camera follows them into the oven, then to a pan where cherry tomatoes burst and pop in garlic oil. Money shot: the roasted eggplant emerging caramelized and collapsed, topped with the burst tomatoes, tahini drizzled in ribbons, pomegranate seeds scattering in slow motion, backlit. Final beat: the platter centered on a set table, impressive. Warm dramatic light, film grain. Dominant sound: the knife scoring, then the tomatoes popping. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
